why: C-TAM-TPB is a technology-acceptance and behavioral-intention model, not a general theory of learning or teaching, and this study-specific combination does not warrant a wiki page.
C-SATS is a named commercial surgical-video assessment platform rather than a general instructional element; its GEARS rubric is a component of that product.
name: C-SATS
product_description: C-SATS is a commercial platform that securely captures operating-room video and coordinates blinded reviewer assessment of surgical technical skill using the GEARS rubric.
